goal: Task-relevant held identity, drawer ownership, action consequences, extra false relations across broader existing A/B geometry
data: All existing 60 A/B coverage roots, 180 four-action branches,720 transitions; no C/D
models: original roots40 joint RSSM seed0/1 unchanged
compatibility: RSSM retains its original symbol head. Object heads operate on current object/global frozen E features, are NOT inserted into RSSM. Their hard relations only feed the separate frozen small relation model as an explicit composed diagnostic.
new_forward: Reuse cached global E, pad last boundary to7 exactly as original evaluator; original 8 posterior samples, seed81831,batch4,BF16,matmul high. Must exactly reproduce old test predictions before new RSSM replay. No DINO or spatial encoder forward.
initial_controls: Same frozen relation model separately receives accurate relation state, native RSSM current hard state, original-object current hard state, coverage-object current hard state. One-step uses actual current observation; free uses only h0 and actions. Physical model receives true before state, original train-only normalization.
hard_decision: Each held/in-drawer probability>=.5, drawer argmax. No thresholds fitted.
soft_mixed_definition: Within hard-all-correct states, mark mixed if any truth-aligned binary confidence<.8 or true drawer probability<.8; retain actual probabilities and wrong-identity mass. This is descriptive, not a calibrated uncertainty detector.
cohorts: Report train40 separately (seen by coverage head only; semantic templates paired to old training roots) and old_band10/gap10 (unseen in training by all compared models). All previously inspected; no fresh blind claim. Per-model root-level overlap CSV.
metrics: Current held identity; post-place InDrawer true positives/false positives; one-step and free1..4 exact fields, full-prefix, changed fields and extra-positive relations; strata starting hard correct/confident vs mixed vs wrong. Root-weighted and A/B separated.
sufficiency: Group real before relation+skill against old train successors/status; preserve new conflicts and examples. No hand-coded dynamics.
